subject: [PATCH v4 1/4] mm/huge_memory: scale thp_underused() to the folio size

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with a Reviewed-by tag, indicating that it meets kernel coding standards and can be applied as-is.

2026-11-03.patch_summary: This patch updates the thp_underused() function to scale its threshold based on the size of the folio, rather than assuming a fixed PMD-sized folio. This change is necessary because future patches will add anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list, which would break the current assumption.

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch updates the thp_underused() function to be aware of the size of a folio, rather than just PMD-sized folios. It scales the khugepaged_max_ptes_none threshold proportionally to the number of pages in the folio, ensuring that the same fraction of zero-filled pages is tolerated for any folio size. This change will prevent issues when collapsing mTHP orders and splitting folios. The patch has no functional changes for PMD-sized folios, as their nr_pages value remains HPAGE_PMD_NR.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Zi Yan suggested adding documentation to clarify that the value of max_ptes_none in thp_underused() function is different from what khugepaged does, and specifically noted that khugepaged_max_ptes_none is mentioned earlier in the code.

Gave Acked-by

It is better to document max_ptes_none is different from what khugepaged does,
especially khugepaged_max_ptes_none is mentioned above.
